title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Smaller groups, more reps
hook: How many balls did each kid field at your last practice?
intro: Twelve kids stand at their positions.
Three of them never get a ball hit to them.
statement: Small groups give every player more reps.
q1: Do you split into small stations with lots of reps —
q2: or play full scrimmages that look like real games?
q3: Who gets more reps in smaller groups?
t1: Every team is different. But skills grow faster
t2: when every kid is part of the play.
ctaLines: Three stations. Short-hop pairs. Live hitting in groups.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How many balls did each kid field at your last practice?
Twelve kids stand at their positions. Three of them never get a ball hit to them.
Small groups give every player more reps.
Small stations or full scrimmages. There is no single right way.
Stations or full scrimmage? Share your habit in the comments.
